summary: The objective of the meeting was to brief the consultant on the electrical scope for two separate project sites (an office building and a factory) and to align on the project governance, required designs, and compliance sign-offs.

keyRisks.impact: Requires proactive oversight to maintain timeline.
The lack of a fixed layout for the factory site may delay final electrical and extraction designs.
keyRisks.mitigation: Await confirmation of the layout before finalizing designs to prevent rework.

keyRisks.impact: Failure to secure necessary HVAC and fire designs by an engineer could delay council approval for the office building.
keyRisks.mitigation: Appoint an electrical engineer promptly to finalize designs and council submission documentation.

criticalDecisions: : The new work scope regarding the office building and the factory will be managed as additional fees to the existing agreement, with invoices processed separately to maintain a clear distinction between the projects.

: The electrical contractor is responsible for executing the installation and issuing the Certificate of Compliance (COC), while the engineer will provide the design and necessary documentation/sign-offs for council approval.

wayForward.task: Finalize technical scope and issue updated project plan
